summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including the integration with Spark 4.1 and improvements for handling large writes. Recent updates also include the release of Iceberg 1.11.0 and ongoing discussions about the REST spec and incremental computation support.
highlights: Discussion on auto flushing data files to manifests for large writes
Proposal for a generic CatalogObjectIdentifier in REST spec
Incremental computation support for compute_table_stats under discussion
